mapper.select: SELECT term_component_id, term_price_id, component_no, component_code, component_type, trigger_code, calculation_base, rate, fixed_amount, currency, min_amount, max_amount, band_mode FROM t_commercial_term_component WHERE term_price_id IN (SELECT term_price_id FROM t_commercial_term_price WHERE term_version_id IN (SELECT term_version_id FROM t_commercial_term_version WHERE term_plan_id IN (SELECT term_plan_id FROM t_commercial_term_plan WHERE client_id = #{clientId} OR local_partner_id IN (SELECT source_partner_id FROM t_entity_source_relation WHERE entity_no IN (SELECT entity_no FROM t_client_entity_affiliation WHERE client_id = #{clientId}) AND source_type='PARTNER'))) AND entity_no IN (SELECT entity_no FROM t_client_entity_affiliation WHERE client_id = #{clientId})) ORDER BY term_component_id
